snippet.title: Garden and a Goat - Open Beta Streamer Clips!
snippet.description:
Thank you very much to all streamers and content creators that participated in our open beta. Here's a few clips of some of the fun we all had. 

Special thanks to the following for these clips!
Mx_Fee - https://twitch.tv/mx_fee 
BlinkBlinkGames - https://twitch.tv/blinkblinkgames 
Viii_Viii8 - https://twitch.tv/viii_viii8 
LIyah LIweth - https://twitch.tv/liyahliweth  

Wishlist now to stay connected and we'll keep you updated on our Steam Next Fest Demo coming in June. Wishlist on Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156550/Garden_and_a_Goat/

Join our Discord to chat with the team and players following the game: https://gardenandagoat.com/discord
